context: Owner decisions 2026-10-05: cutover ships with release v0.4.2 (tag must contain website/). Order: (1) PR #2656 (site-deploy hardening, acceptance gaps, parity approvals) merges; (2) dlv2-62 publication cutover with owner github-pages approvals and admin deletions; (3) parity re-run on the cutover base; owner signs _project/decisions/astro-parity-signoff.md; (4) v0.4.2 release + PyPI by owner; (5) cutover PR flips deploy/routes.yml to renderer: auto and carries the item-21 visual approval rehearsal; owner sets SITE_DEPLOY_VISUAL_APPROVED_BINDING/REASON for the first Astro deploy. description:
Go only if all of these hold:
- the G2 URL compatibility sign-off is re-run on the cutover base SHA
- site-deploy has an all-Astro preview with a rollback drill on record (astro-site-52)
- the owner approves in writing

Sequence:
1. PR to develop:
   - make site-build a required context, with its drift guard, in the same PR
   - switch visual capture to the Astro render, with intentional approvals in both slots per astro-site-03
   - set routes.yml to select Astro from the next release
   Sphinx still builds docs/ and still renders production.
2. Cut the next release through the normal release flow. The tag now contains website/ and all migrated content.
3. site-deploy builds one all-Astro artifact: / and /docs/ from the tag; /docs/dev/, /blog/ and /results/ from trunk. Deploy, probe every route, record the receipt.
4. Run one production rollback drill to the last Sphinx artifact by receipt, then roll forward.

Rollback triggers: any probe failure, a broken URL or fragment against the inventory, or a changed feed id. Response: redeploy the prior artifact by receipt. Mixed-renderer artifacts are never a fallback (D13).
